caption: The drawing features a single, finely detailed object centered within a lightly outlined square frame. The object is an oval shape with a smaller, intricately decorated oval inset. Inside the decoration, there is a symmetrical floral motif at the center, surrounded by four mirrored, swirling, leaf-like patterns radiating outward. The lines are drawn in fine pencil, giving the image a monochromatic, grayscale appearance. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset that displays the object’s dimensions and side profile; it shows the oval from a top view with the measurements “1 3/4” (height) and “3” (width) labeled, and a side view with the thickness marked as “7/16.” The drawing is neatly executed on off-white or cream-colored paper, and the artist’s name, “Hans Westendorff,” is printed in small capital letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Silver Patch Box
